gaps.explanation: Statement of Activities and Governmental Funds Revenues, Expenditures, and Changes In Fund Balances and Net Position - Cash Basis (p2) prints 10 columns; detail[] has budget schedules for General (p3), Street (p4), Fire and EMS (p5) and New 1/2 Cent Sales Tax (p6) only. TOTAL REVENUES of the columns with no schedule: Debt Service 770,838 (Property Taxes 540,289 + Sales Taxes 88 + Special Assessments 185,169 + Intergovernmental 16,013 + Interest 29,279), 1/2 cent Sales Tax 0, Capital Projects 103,539 (Special Assessments), Chestnut Street Project 519,559 (Sales Taxes 491,670 + Interest 27,889), Other Governmental Funds 705,508 (Permits and Fees 600 + Intergovernmental 69,654 + Interest 162 + Keno Receipts 33,757 + Grants 576,591 + Miscellaneous 24,744). 770,838 + 103,539 + 519,559 + 705,508 = 2,099,444 = gap. Check: 7,377,225 + 2,099,444 = 9,476,669 = statement total.
